description: Watch the luggage carts that bell services wheel through the lobby. A Mickey-shaped cutout is worked into the cart's frame.

whereToLook.scene: The grand lobby, the luggage carts in use
whereToLook.exactSpot: The frame of a cart. A Mickey cutout in the metalwork.

bestTip: Wait near the bell services stand and a cart will come to you.

viewing.notes: The carts roll with the bellhops, so you may need to wait for one to pass. Check that the current carts still carry the cutout.
